subtitle: Reusable server rules for games with friends, with controls for each mod.
intro: Save server settings once, select them in Play with friends, and share the same cfg in chat.
dropHint: You can also drag one .cfg file anywhere onto this screen.
dropTitle: Drop the .cfg file to import it
dropRelease: Release it anywhere on this screen.
dropOneCfg: Drag one .cfg file at a time.
emptyTitle: Your server rules, ready to reuse
empty: Create a config for your mod or import a cfg file. You can edit it before starting a server.
name: Config name
modHint: The mod selects the available controls. Changing it keeps your cfg text. Install that mod in the client used to host.
fieldsHint: Controls update the cfg text. Unlisted commands and comments stay intact. Default values are not written until you change a setting.
invalidField: Enter a valid value within the field limits. Text cannot contain quotes or line breaks.
issuesHint: You can save this config as a draft. Resolve these commands before using it to host a game.
ignoredTitle: Some cfg lines are not used
ignoredHint: They stay in the document for compatibility, but JKNet does not send them to the private server.
removeHint: Delete “{{name}}” from your saved server configs?
copyFailed: The clipboard is unavailable. Focus the launcher and try copying again.
importHint: Choose a cfg file or paste its text. A cfg shared by JKNet restores its game, mod and name. Other files use the active game; choose their mod in the editor.
invalidHeader: The JKNet config header is invalid or uses an unsupported game or mod. Check the first line before importing.
tooLarge: A server config can contain at most 64 KiB of text.
nameTooLong: Shorten the config name to at most 240 UTF-8 bytes.
readFailed: The cfg file could not be read. Choose the file again.
sensitive: Copying, exporting and sharing are unavailable while the cfg contains credentials: {{keys}}. Remove these assignments in Cfg text. Set the join password in Play with friends.
